public.text: The statement that the Client Registry contains identity data rather than health data is conceptually useful, but identity and demographic attributes can themselves be sensitive health-related information in context.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that the registry does not contain clinical records, while its identity and demographic data remain sensitive personal data subject to health-sector privacy, security, and purpose restrictions.
